name: TypeScript language server for devc web
description: Installs devc-lsp-typescript, the launcher devc web uses for TypeScript and JavaScript intelligence: deno lsp under a deno.json, the workspace's own TypeScript 7+ language server, or vtsls on the workspace's TypeScript (bundled TypeScript 5.9.3 when there is none). Brings its own Node; changes nothing in the image's Node or the workspace.

server.description: Container-wide default for which server to run; devc web's Language server settings can override it per project. auto: deno lsp for a Deno root, the workspace's TypeScript 7+ language server when the project depends on it, else vtsls.

settings.description: A JSON object deep-merged into the settings devc web gives the language server (workspace/configuration), e.g. {"typescript":{"tsserver":{"maxTsServerMemory":8192}}}. A per-project value from devc web replaces this one.
